name: Sunobinop
summary: Sunobinop (developmental code names V117957; IMB-115) is a high affinity small molecule nociceptin receptor partial agonist. As of February 2024, it is under clinical investigation for the treatment of insomnia, alcohol use disorder, interstitial cystitis, and overactive bladder syndrome. It was previously also under investigation for the treatment of fibromyalgia.

pharmacology.text: Sunobinop has nanomolar affinity (Ki) and efficacy (EC50) at human recombinant nociceptin/orphanin-FQ peptide (NOP) receptors. It has a high degree of functional selectivity for the NOP receptor. Sunobinop is a low affinity antagonist at human mu and kappa opioid receptors, and is a low affinity weak partial agonist at human delta opioid receptors.

uses.text: As of February 2024, it is under clinical investigation for the treatment of insomnia, alcohol use disorder, interstitial cystitis, and overactive bladder syndrome. It was previously also under investigation for the treatment of fibromyalgia.

sideEffects.en: Little has been published about its side effects in people. As it is being studied as a sleep aid, drowsiness would be expected.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它在人體的副作用，已發表的資料很少。由於它正被研究作為助眠藥，預期會造成嗜睡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它在人体的副作用，已发表的数据很少。由于它正被研究作为助眠药，预期会造成嗜睡。

fact.en: It acts on the nociceptin receptor, the fourth member of the opioid receptor family. When this receptor was discovered in 1994 it was called an orphan receptor, because its natural partner was not yet known.
fact.zh: 它作用於痛敏肽受體，這是鴉片受體家族的第四位成員。這個受體在1994年被發現時被稱為「孤兒受體」，因為當時還不知道與它配對的天然物質是什麼。
fact.zhHans: 它作用于痛敏肽受体，这是鸦片受体家族的第四位成员。这个受体在1994年被发现时被称为「孤儿受体」，因为当时还不知道与它配对的天然物质是什么。
